name: @dub/mo1-ios
description: MO1 — iOS SwiftUI participant/staff app. P0 = TypeScript contract-consumption reference layer (ApiClient, auth/refresh, semi-open error mapping, optimistic task UI, push deeplink routing, SWR read cache) that locks the MO3 `mobile` namespace contract the Swift app consumes. Production target is Swift 5.10+/SwiftUI/iOS17+ (see README).
